dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: How are you coping with the battles so far?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I can't always check how you're faring in the middle of a fight. Hopefully you're not pushing yourself too hard.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: If any of our foes give you a hard time, send them my way.
